The '''funeral of Padmé Amidala''' was the ceremonial funeral procession of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. It took place after her death in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] in [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].

==Overview==
After her death in childbirth on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]], Amidala's body was returned to Naboo for the proper funeral rites. In order to hide the fact that Amidala's [[Twin/Legends|twins]] survived, her body was prepared to still appear pregnant.<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith novel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> Her maternal grandmother, [[Ryoo Thule]], oversaw Amidala's funeral, as per Naboo custom.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref>

[[File:Amidalafuneral.png|thumb|left|200px|Amidala's body in her casket as it is drawn through the streets of Theed.]]
Drawn through the streets of Theed in a four-[[Gualaar/Legends|gualaar]] carriage, Amidala's body was seen as drowning in a watery casket, as her funeral gown was several different shades of blue and her hair was fanned appropriately. The [[Japor snippet/Legends|japor snippet]] given to her by her secret husband, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[32 BBY/Legends|thirteen years earlier]] rested in her folded hands as well. Thousands of mourners witnessed or followed the procession, which was led by [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]], [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]], Amidala's [[Naberrie family/Legends|family]] and her former [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]], who acted as pallbearers.<ref name="ROTS" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] watched Amidala's funeral from Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']]. They didn't want to take the risk to come any closer and be found by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], as they were certain that [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] attention would be fixed on the funeral.<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'' junior novelization]]</ref>

Although Naboo custom dictated that the deceased was to be cremated at the [[Theed Funeral Temple/Legends|Theed Funeral Temple]] and their ashes cast into the Solleu River before plunging off the cliff from the bridge between the Livet Tower and the temple,<ref name="SW:CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Padmé Amidala's lifeless body was subsequently [[Burial/Legends|entombed]] in a stone sarcophagus ornated with the [[Naboo royal crest/Legends|Naboo emblem]] and located in a [[Tomb of Padmé Amidala/Legends|private mausoleum]].<ref name="Topps7">{{Topps|set=2012 Topps Star Wars Galaxy Series 7|cardname=Mourning for Padmé}}</ref>

==Aftermath==
Amidala's friend and colleague, Senator [[Silya Shessaun/Legends|Silya Shessaun]], attempted to start an investigation to look further into Amidala's untimely death. Shessaun's efforts were thwarted by the newly-appointed Emperor Palpatine, citing "security concerns".<ref name="db-Shessaun" />

Amidala's former handmaiden, [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], was equally frustrated by what little she knew of her friend and former mistress's death. She eventually befriended Senator Bail Organa and became one of his principal agents. She was also asked by Organa to tutor Amidala's daughter, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], and her companion [[Winter Celchu|Winter]] in a variety of subjects, from etiquette and bureaucracy to the more esoteric arts.<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

[[18 BBY/Legends|Six months after the funeral]], [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] traveled to Naboo seeking information on Amidala and her pregnancy, suspecting that her offspring might have survived. He interrogated Ryoo Thule, since she had overseen her granddaughter's funeral. When she refused to give him the information he sought, he killed her.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo" />

Additionally, Amidala's head of security, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]], began an investigation into the late Senator's mysterious death, as he had developed an unrequited love for her. Typho eventually came to the conclusion that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] had killed Amidala. When he finally confronted the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], the latter struck him down. Before dying, Typho took some satisfaction in the obvious pain that Amidala's name caused Vader.<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows" /> Vader himself would eventually pay a visit to the mausoleum housing her remains, proceeding to grieve at the location.<ref name="Topps7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The various mourners in the background of the funeral scenes were primarily played by employees of [[Industrial Light & Magic]] and JAK shot against a bluescreen.<ref name="Mourning Throng">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/explore/sithsnap/2006/03/20060322.html|text=Sith Snapshots &mdash; Mourning Throng}}</ref>
